published_source: Printed Table 4 ('Effects of Giveaway Monetization on Average Book Ratings and Number of Reviews'), 'Number of Ratings' block, first column (Post-Giveaway only; the third of the four printed columns) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2023.01390.pdf, p. 2392), read Nov 4 2026: Post-Giveaway 11.008*** (0.182), Number of books 81,608, Observations 2,036,383, adjusted R2 0.131, book FE and year-month FE; equals the authors' code output 11.0077 (0.1822), N 2,036,383, to the printed decimals (authors_code_* hold the fixest re-run of the authors' felm call on the package data). Earlier: no published_source field; the published 11.008 (0.182) came from the package tex output (results/demand/tex_files) and the screening record, see the replication log.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 11.0077 (0.1822), N 2,036,383, equals printed Table 4 'Number of Ratings' first column 11.008 (0.182), N 2,036,383, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: felm(N ~ post_giveaway | book_id + yearmon | 0 | book_id) on u_sub = review_vol_yearmon.Rds restricted to diff_month in [-12,12] around each book's own giveaway month (code/demand/02_demand_results.R line 335). Prepared file = the authors' review_vol_yearmon.Rds with the authors' window filter applied and yearmon converted to an integer month index (ym = round(12*yearmon) = year*12 + month - 1); no other changes. post_giveaway = 1(yearmon > giveaway_yearmon), so treatment starts the month after the giveaway month. All 81,608 books are eventually treated (no never-treated units); 51 monthly cohorts 2016-01..2020-03; untreated (not-yet-treated) comparisons exist in treated months 2016-02..2020-03 but not in 2020-04..2020-12 (50,972 treated book-months, 2.5% of the sample). fixest replication: 11.0077 (0.1822), N 2,036,383, 81,608 books, SD(N) 38.676.
